system.description:
Most animals find Kindred frightening, but with Animal Ken you understand what drives beasts and how to assuage their fears. You can train an animal (especially a ghoul) to particular behaviors — stay, fetch, attack — or deduce its state (injured, angry, frightened) with a Mental Challenge.

Given time (roughly a month), you can teach an animal a simple trick, up to one trick per Mental Trait it possesses. Animal Ken is frequently paired with the Animalism Discipline.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Character Creation and Traits
